spans.s: (akaḍama-cakra) n. a mystic (circular) diagram in- scribed with four groups of alphabet beginning with अ, क, ड, म respectively, and used to find out what response a particular mantra may give to a particular spiritual aspirant. This response is indicated by the designations सिद्ध (accomplished), साध्य (yet to be accomplished), सुसिद्ध (well-accomplished) and अरि (adverse); अथाकडमचक्रम् TantrSā. (K) 11. 7.

(akaḍamādi-ka) n. a symbolic diagram in which the Sanskrit alphabet is written under four groups of twelve syllables each, beginning with अ, क, ड and म respectively एतत् ते कथितं देवि ! अकडमा- दिकमुत्तमम् TantrSā(K) 11. 8.
(a-kāḍila) adj. [optionally अकाडाल] without foot-disease ऊचेऽथ जाङ्गलनृपः…अकालालोकालिलं तमिति संप्रहरस्व दोष्मन्। …अघाटालाका- डिलैः। …हतैः किमेभिः
